Beta release. Expect rough edges.

**Install:** download the installer for your system below, open it and press Install.

| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows | `PrivacyCleanupInstaller-windows-x64.exe` (`-arm64` for ARM PCs) |
| macOS | `PrivacyCleanupInstaller-macos-apple-silicon.zip` or `-intel.zip`, unzip, then right-click → Open |
| Linux | `PrivacyCleanupInstaller-linux-x64` (`-arm64`), `chmod +x` then run |

The installers aren't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper will warn on first launch. Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Using client mods breaks Discord's Terms of Service. Deleted messages can't be recovered.
